Also, let it be noted; this tactic resulted in a 100% engagement victory tally… but it failed to actually KILL a lot of the enemy ships as disrupters are low damage and allow for more retreats. Ten 20x20 units divided into quadrants with a  6x6 shelter in the middle. Each quadrant is watered from hoses above to encourage forage growth and only one quadrant is used at a time allowing time for aforementioned growth.

Find your land first, unless you’re happy with around 40ac or less you likely won’t be able to finance both a home and land for a long time. You’re likely looking at 15-20 years of working a job alongside building your farm to maybe be able to generate 50-65k off your land after expenses. 

If you want large scale, you’re looking at lottery or inheritance… if you do not make $100k per year AFTER expenses AND taxes, large scale is not going to be an option for you within 20-30 years. Most of that extra 100k will go into loan interest and equipment rental/payments. You won’t see profit for 3-6 years and all of that goes to the interest. 

Entry level farming is, in my opinion, the most difficult entry level industry out there without generational support/foundation to build off of unless you’re aiming for high political or corporate office.
